settings.heading: The right yak chew for your Rottweiler.
settings.subheading: Rottweilers have some of the strongest jaws of any breed. They need an XL chew that can withstand serious pressure without splintering or shattering.
settings.estimate_note: Rottweilers (80–135 lbs) are power-chewers. Start with XL. Duration is shorter than lighter breeds due to jaw strength — but the chew is still safer than any alternative.
settings.card_1_text: Rottweilers weigh 80–135 lbs with extremely strong jaws. Always use XL. A Large is a choking hazard for this breed — they can break it into swallowable pieces too quickly.
settings.card_2_text: With power-chewers this strong, supervision is critical. Check the chew every 10–15 minutes. Remove it when it gets small enough to fit entirely in their mouth.
settings.card_3_text: Rottweiler owners often try antlers or marrow bones. Both can crack teeth. Yak chews are dense enough to last but have just enough give to prevent tooth fractures — the safer choice for strong jaws.
